title: No rate-limiting on NNTP TAKETHIS/IHAVE flood per peer
description: transit/peering/session.rs:110-157: the session task reads CHECK/TAKETHIS commands and enqueues articles with no per-peer rate limit. A malicious peer can sustain continuous 431 responses by sending valid-format articles (passing format/size/msgid checks) that fail deduplication, keeping the ingestion queue perpetually full and blocking legitimate peers. The queue is bounded so this is not a memory exhaustion issue, but it is a DoS against legitimate ingestion. Fix: add a token bucket or per-connection rate limiter on accepted TAKETHIS commands.
